data.desc: cbdMD, Inc. (NYSE American:YCBD) is a wellness company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, whose portfolio spans the fundamentals to the frontier of wellness. The Company's brands include Twinlab, Reserveage, Metabolife, ResVitale, cbdMD, Paw CBD, Oasis and Bluebird Botanicals, offered through retail, wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. Guided by the promise of More Life in Every Day, cbdMD is committed to quality, transparency and innovation.
